status: campaign executed 2026-10-26; frozen protocol parameters unchanged

preserved_from_v1.organization: enumerate the same six one-agent-per-task assignments; equal-task-weight validation error; lexicographic tie-break
preserved_from_v1.test_selection: test data are evaluation-only; O0 and all readapted assignments use validation

information_protocol_v2.split_stream: same deterministic seed derivation as v1 with T3 split index 3; disjoint from original train, validation and test streams

conditions.C1_direct_labels: warm-start A1 refit on the new T3 inputs with true labels
conditions.C2_A3_distillation: warm-start A1 refit on the same inputs with A3 soft probabilities only
conditions.C3_permuted_A3_distillation: warm-start A1 refit on the same inputs with A3 soft probabilities permuted across examples

optimizer_budget.target_encoding: each original example expanded to two weighted class rows for all three updates; per-example weights sum to one
optimizer_budget.realized_iterations_and_wall_time: recorded; may differ due to convergence and input weights

information_protocol_v2.interpretation_caveat: C2-C1 compares teacher-derived soft targets with true labels. By itself it does not identify positive or negative transfer because the information supplied differs.

organization.O0: initial-model validation optimum, held fixed under C0-C3
organization.readapted: validation optimum for each updated condition C1-C3; C0 aliases O0 without duplicating its observation
organization.recorded_assignment_values: all six validation utilities per condition
organization.recorded_test_metrics: complete agent-by-task accuracy and log-loss matrices for C0-C3

statistics.contrasts: all pairwise treatment differences for individual A1 task outcomes and collective fixed/readapted outcomes; readapted-minus-fixed within C1-C3
